unit_of_independence.proposed: Original patient/stay,with all linked BIDMC/MIMIC recordings,channels and windows grouped together.

proposed_policy.train: Fit preprocessing and model parameters only on separately verified training patient/stay groups.
proposed_policy.validation: Use disjoint verified patient/stay groups;keep overlapping or adjacent windows and repeated channels together.
proposed_policy.test: Reserve unseen verified patient/stay groups;check MIMIC/BIDMC duplication before allocation.The single selected recording cannot supply an independent test.
